feature.name: Update the app
feature.description: Signed releases update automatically; a check can be started from the menu.

requirements.text: Only a packaged build updates itself: not in dev, not in smoke runs, not with PC_DISABLE_AUTO_UPDATE, on Linux only the AppImage

acceptance.text: canAutoUpdate is true only for a packaged build outside smoke runs and without PC_DISABLE_AUTO_UPDATE

decisions.decision: macOS installs updates only into a signed app; Windows builds stay unsigned
